0022600194.text: The Rockets (7-2) are first in the Southwest and third in the West, though they dropped their most recent game, while the Suns (1-5) are 12th in the West and have lost four straight. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Phoenix will be without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and Houston won all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently a 119-105 road win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
